name: Gudini Shinobi World
targetFeel: the drawing style and character design of a Naruto-style shinobi anime; the style is what is locked, not the setting
visualLanguage: stylized cinematic anime, clean line art, cel shading with soft painterly backgrounds, strong readable silhouettes, cinematic anime lighting, stylized anime action language; every person in every shot is drawn as a character of this anime, including real-world or other-franchise people
architecture: places follow the story: a city street, a battlefield, a lab, a spaceship, a stadium — anything the speech is about, drawn in this anime style. The hidden shinobi village (tiled roofs, wooden houses, training grounds, forests) is only the default when the speech has no place of its own
clothingRules: Gudini and shinobi characters: flak/tactical vests, forehead protectors with original village emblems, wrapped forearms and lower legs, open-toe shinobi sandals, utility pouches, dark high-collar layers. Characters from the story keep their own iconic look, redrawn as anime: armor, capes, suits, uniforms are allowed when the story is about them
technologyRules: shinobi world props by default: scrolls, seals, paper documents, notice boards, messenger birds, lanterns, ink, chakra mechanisms and scroll-tech. Technology from the story (powered armor, spaceships, phones, computers, cars) is drawn as anime tech when the speech is about it
socialRules: the cast and society come from the story itself; shinobi villages and clans appear only when the speech has no cast or setting of its own
powerSystem: hand signs and chakra-like visible energy for shinobi characters; characters from the story keep their own powers, weapons and effects drawn in anime style; no gore, no graphic violence
recurringObjects: for Gudini: mission scrolls, forehead protector, kunai, utility pouch, paper lanterns; for the story: its own iconic objects (a glowing chest reactor, a round shield, a golden gauntlet, a metal arm) drawn recognizably
environmentRules: one consistent drawing style in every shot; lighting and palette follow the scene, the anime look never changes
contentRules: CONTENT IS LITERAL: the viewer sees exactly what the author is talking about — the people, events, objects and places named in the speech — drawn in this anime style
Do NOT translate the subject into shinobi metaphors (no clans instead of companies, no scrolls instead of films, no masked warlords instead of real villains)

Name well-known characters directly in the prompt (Tony Stark, Thanos, Bucky Barnes, Captain America, Doctor Doom) and add a short iconic look so the drawing is recognizable: red-and-gold powered armor with a glowing chest reactor; a giant purple titan with a golden gauntlet; a soldier with a silver metal arm; a round star-spangled shield; a green cloak and a metal mask

Gudini is a silent character inside the story, not a narrator: he plays a role in the events (a fighter beside the heroes, a witness on the battlefield, the one who picks up the fallen hero's helmet), never speaks, never looks at or addresses the camera
Locations follow the story and are drawn in this anime style; the shinobi village is used only when the speech has no place of its own
Supporting cast follows the speech: as many story characters as the beat needs, each named and drawn consistently across shots
forbiddenDrift: photorealism; 3D render look; a different anime style mid-video; replacing the story's real people, places and events with shinobi metaphors; forcing the shinobi village into a story that has its own places; changing Gudini's design; Gudini talking or looking at the camera; text, logos or watermarks in frame
